# uses writing system

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usesWritingSystem`](gmeow-usesWritingSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usesWritingSystem>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

Relates a language to a writing system it is written in — the direct relation. Non-functional and CO-EQUAL: Japanese uses Han, Hiragana, Katakana and Latin simultaneously, none primary. When role or period matter, reify the binding as [`gmeow:WritingSystemUsage`](../classes/gmeow-WritingSystemUsage.md).
